Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in, when I enter customer and vehicle details and click Bind, then a policy number is generated.
Given a policy with risk score > 80, when I click Approve, then status changes to Approved and audit trail is saved.
Given a valid policy, when address is changed and saved, then endorsement is created and premium difference is shown.
Given a policy is active, when I submit FNOL with loss details, then a claim number is created with status Open.
Given a policy with outstanding premium, when I capture card payment, then receipt is stored and balance is updated.
